messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

item: "response to them may be reduced"
set: ["response to them may be reduced", "reduced risk of excessive response", "dosage should be adjusted according to patient response", "blocking them", "poor response to insulin", "may be habit-forming", "reduced effectiveness", "reduced alertness", "may not be safe to breastfeed", "reduced appetite", "if satisfactory response does not occur within one hour, dose may be increased to 80 mg", "dose increases should be based on clinical response", "may not be safe", "adjusted according to blood pressure response", "not everyone experiences them", "reduced weight gain"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
